name: business-finance
title: Business finance
description: A business finance dashboard in Tiles: income against payments, a growth ring against target, a stock sparkline, activity and a verification checklist.

props.name: data
props.type: { cashflow: AreaPoint[]; income: number; incomeChange: number; growth: number; growthTarget: string; stock: { label: string; value: number }[]; stockName: string; activity: Transaction[]; …
props.description: The cash flow, income, growth, stock, activity and verification steps to show.

props.name: format
props.description: How amounts are formatted. Default euro with no decimals.

props.name: note
props.description: Footer text on the cash flow tile. Default "Example data."

props.name: today
props.description: "YYYY-MM-DD" of today, so the activity list reads "Today" and "Yesterday". Default the day of `now`.

props.name: now
props.description: The current time. Used for `today` when that is not given.

props.name: labels
props.type: { income?: string; payments?: string; growth?: string; ofTarget?: string; stock?: string; activity?: string; verification?: string; stepsDone?: (done: number, total: number) => string; done?: …
props.description: Visible text and screen reader text, with English defaults.

a11y.text: An h1 and tiles named by their h2. The legend marks income with a square and payments with a dashed line, as in the chart; the marks are aria-hidden and the names are text. The growth donut is labelled "Growth, {pct} percent of {target}". The verification list writes each state "(Done)" or "(To do)" and the check mark is aria-hidden; the footer reads "{d} of {t} steps done". See BigNumber and DeltaPill from chart-kit, area-chart, donut, sparkline and transaction-list (limit 4).
